stryker-config.comment: Mutation testing for the documentation pipeline. A SECOND config rather than entries in stryker-config.json because Stryker mutates one 'project' per run. This library exists as a non-test project precisely so it can be mutated: Stryker treats test projects as the test-projects, so a renderer living in DwarfMapper.Generator.Tests could never be a mutation target, and nothing would prove the doc tests catch a defect in the renderer itself. Run via scripts/housekeeping.ps1 -Mutation (needs: dotnet tool install -g dotnet-stryker).
